conventions.pivot: absolute viewBox coordinates in the rest pose
conventions.parent: logical rig parent. SVG nesting matches it for tail-1..4, arm upper/lower and everything inside head; tail, legs, body, bag, arms and head are siblings under shekru to keep back-to-front draw order, so a body transform must also be applied to its logical children (or just transform shekru).
conventions.drawOrderNote: Arms sit under the head, so a paw raised beside the face tucks behind the cheek. For hand-on-face poses (listening, thinking) draw that arm above head for the duration of the pose (Rive draw-order key, or render the arm group after head in code).
conventions.placement: Art is scaled 0.86 and offset so the tail stays inside the viewBox when every tail segment is rotated +-15deg; the rest pose therefore sits left of centre.

shekru.notes: Root. Pivot at ground centre between the feet; use for whole-character squash/stretch, hop and sway.

tail-1.notes: Tail base, hidden behind the hips. Sway +-15deg. Drawn under its parent: round base tucked under the round end of the parent, both centred on this pivot; every joint sits at a fur notch.

tail-2.notes: Mid tail. Follow-through, delay ~3 frames after tail-1. Drawn under its parent: round base tucked under the round end of the parent, both centred on this pivot; every joint sits at a fur notch.

tail-3.notes: Upper tail, follow-through. Drawn under its parent: round base tucked under the round end of the parent, both centred on this pivot; every joint sits at a fur notch.

tail-4.notes: Curl + cream tip (the cream starts inside this segment, not at the joint). Flick +-20deg. Drawn under its parent: round base tucked under the round end of the parent, both centred on this pivot; every joint sits at a fur notch.

tail.notes: Wrapper for the whole tail; same pivot as tail-1. Segments are nested tail-1 > tail-2 > tail-3 > tail-4.

leg-l.notes: Hip. Whole leg incl. foot is one piece; top is tucked under the belly. Foot sole on ground y=470.

leg-r.notes: Hip. Whole leg incl. foot is one piece; top is tucked under the belly. Foot sole on ground y=470.

body.notes: Torso: maroon back/shoulders behind a cream front, plus the ruff shadow. Pivot at ground centre for squash/stretch (apply the same transform to the shekru root so limbs, head and tail follow).

bag.notes: Strap + bag. Sits on the torso only (no arm joint crossed); strap top is hidden under the chin. Small swing +-6deg about the pivot.

arm-l-upper.notes: Shoulder. Round cap r=16 centred on the pivot, sits over the torso. Raising the arm outward is a positive rotation.

arm-l-lower.notes: Elbow. Forearm + paw; upper arm and forearm both end in an r=12.5 circle centred on this pivot, seamless to +-60deg.

arm-r-upper.notes: Shoulder. Round cap r=16 centred on the pivot, sits over the torso. Raising the arm outward is a negative rotation.

arm-r-lower.notes: Elbow. Forearm + paw; upper arm and forearm both end in an r=12.5 circle centred on this pivot, seamless to +-60deg.

neck-ruff.notes: Chest fur under the chin, first (lowest) child of head so it overlaps strap and shoulders. Static inside head.

ear-l.notes: Ear base, tucked under head-base. Twitch +-15deg.

ear-r.notes: Ear base, tucked under head-base. Twitch +-15deg.

cheeks.notes: Blush. Fade opacity up for happy / shy.

eye-l-pupil.notes: Pupil r=16.5 inside a 23x25 white; keep gaze offsets within about +-5 px so it stays inside.

eye-l-eyelid.notes: Blink: hidden by default; show for 2-3 frames (or scaleY 0->1 from the pivot at the top of the eye).

eye-r-pupil.notes: Pupil r=16.5 inside a 23x25 white; keep gaze offsets within about +-5 px so it stays inside.

eye-r-eyelid.notes: Blink: hidden by default; show for 2-3 frames (or scaleY 0->1 from the pivot at the top of the eye).

eyes.notes: Both open eyes. Hide when eyes-happy is shown.

eyes-happy.notes: Closed happy arcs. When shown, hide the eyes group.

mouth.notes: Viseme container. Exactly one child visible. All visemes hang from the same anchor (philtrum end, x=166 y=233) and stay inside a 72x44 box.

head.notes: Neck. The chin overlaps the torso top by ~20 px, so +-15deg tilt shows no gap. Contains ears, face and mouth.

head-base.notes: Maroon skull + cream face mask (static inside head).
